claim_review.method: Parent-agent review of every document against its cited repository source, a forbidden-phrase scan, and three delegated read-only audits against a written facts contract
claim_review.drafting: Delegated model drafts for the community files, changelog, release notes, documentation index, announcement, outreach copy and design-partner guide; the parent agent wrote the README, status relocation, positioning, launch plan, checklist, demo script and kit index. Model output is not evidence
positive_cases: A reader reaches clone, development shell, tests, demo output and dashboard preview from the README top
A reader finds the license map, the security reporting route, the contribution route and the hosted-CI status from the README
Every capability row carries an evidence word and links its procedure
negative_cases: No document claims production readiness, a sandbox, hostile isolation, an SLA or a support response time
No document presents hosted CI as available, priced, in beta or open for signup
No document claims permissive-only licensing, GitHub Actions compatibility, exactly-once behavior or a SLSA level
Gitea, Forgejo and Tangled are named fixture-tested wherever they appear
No historical receipt is presented as validation of the current revision
No invented domain, email, handle, customer, price or benchmark appears
